items.title: Bosses want you to use AI. Then they credit the AI
items.summary: Companies are ordering staff to lean on AI, then handing the credit to the machine. Researchers call it the AI penalty, and workers say it is costing them promotions and raises. Aubrey spent more than a year on a project to speed up a costly medical manufactu…
items.titleZh: 老板们想让你使用人工智能。然后他们把功劳归功于人工智能
items.summaryZh: 公司正在命令员工依靠人工智能，然后将功劳交给机器。研究人员称之为人工智能惩罚，员工们表示这会让他们失去晋升和加薪的机会。奥布里花了一年多的时间来加速一个昂贵的医疗制造项目…

items.title: Michael Burry's grim warnings are a 'godsend,' star tech investor says
items.summary: Tech investor Gavin Baker said he's "grateful" to Michael Burry as he wants "a really smart person who's credibly banging a bearish drum."
items.titleZh: 明星科技投资者迈克尔·伯里的严厉警告是“天赐之物”
items.summaryZh: 科技投资者加文·贝克（Gavin Baker）表示，他“感谢”迈克尔·伯里（Michael Burry），因为他想要“一个真正聪明的人，可信地敲着看跌鼓”

items.title: Hyundai’s electric hatch starts at under $30,000, and interest is already sky-high
items.summary: The IONIQ 3 has received the “highest-ever” levels of customer interest for any Hyundai model (EV or gas), with prices starting under $30,000.
items.titleZh: 现代的电动舱口起价不到3万美元，而且人们的兴趣已经非常高了
items.summaryZh: IONIQ 3在所有现代车型（电动汽车或汽油）中都获得了“有史以来最高”的客户兴趣，价格低于30000美元。

items.title: SpaceX stock sinks for a second-straight day, nearing $135 IPO price
items.summary: SpaceX went public a month ago in a record IPO. Elon Musk's space and AI company was added to the Nasdaq-100 last week.
items.titleZh: SpaceX股价连续第二天下跌，IPO价格接近135美元
items.summaryZh: 一个月前，SpaceX以创纪录的IPO上市。埃隆·马斯克的太空和人工智能公司上周被列入纳斯达克100强。

items.title: SpaceX cleared to fly Starship again after booster failure in May
items.summary: This will be the first Starship test flight for SpaceX as a public company, testing the market's appetite for the company's "fly, fail, fix" approach to rocket development, which often ends in fireballs.
items.titleZh: 5月助推器故障后，SpaceX获准再次飞行星际飞船
items.summaryZh: 这将是SpaceX作为上市公司进行的首次星际飞船试飞，测试市场对该公司“飞行、失败、修复”火箭开发方法的兴趣，这种方法往往以火球告终。

items.title: The 10 best state economies in America in 2026
items.summary: Economy is one of the most important categories in CNBC’s annual America’s Top States for Business rankings. Several states stand out for economic strength.
items.summaryZh: 经济是CNBC年度美国商业排名中最重要的类别之一。几个州因经济实力而脱颖而出。

items.title: A $5M startup claims rare earth-free electric motor breakthrough
items.summary:
A Bengaluru startup called Vimag Labs just secured its fifth Indian patent for an electric motor that runs without any rare-earth magnets, using software and power electronics to generate its magnetic field instead.
It’s a small, $5-million company taking a s…
items.titleZh: 一家500万美元的初创公司声称无稀土电机取得突破
items.summaryZh: 班加罗尔一家名为Vimag Labs的初创公司刚刚获得了其第五项印度专利，该专利涉及一种不使用任何稀土磁铁运行的电动机，它使用软件和电力电子设备来产生磁场。
